decision: accepted source boundary; final browser/visual receiving separate
findings: Every input edit marks previous result as retained draft and disables inspection/observation. Native Apply reads one complete integer snapshot, including zero-step initial row; refusal retains accepted result but leaves export retired.
Preset changes only populate/retire; row/cell controls can inspect only while live. The static model is immutable and accepted input is detached.

Approximate chart uses one scale from all accepted rows, retains signed values, and is explicitly separated from exact values and continuous solutions. Zero field gets a nondegenerate scale; initial row has no incoming transition.
Range/squared-deviation wording is nonincrease rather than strict smoothing, includes both endpoint caveats, and distinguishes growing alternating mode from constant preservation.

Observation download contains full exact model plus current selected row/cell, is guarded by live, and uses the accepted snapshot rather than draft text. Fixed course/guide downloads remain independent and preserve their exact source strings.

DOM dynamic text uses textContent and SVG text nodes. Builder preserves raw course/guide text with script-closing-safe string serialization, rejects model/UI closing tags and replaces each marker exactly once.
Current responsive layout uses minmax(0,1fr) and contained horizontal table scrollers; actual capture assessment remains pending.
limits: Source review only. No owner tests, browser replay, UI automation or learner run. Actual file downloads/rendering require owner browser receipt.
